title: The solar expo booth
intro: You walk up to a booth at a solar expo. Carlos works there. Start a conversation.

npc.es: Hola, bienvenido. ¿Es tu primera vez en este evento?
npc.en: Hello, welcome. Is this your first time at this event?

opts.es: Sí, es mi primera vez aquí
opts.en: Yes, it's my first time here

steps.why: He asked about the event, not how you are.

npc.es: Mucho gusto. Me llamo Carlos. ¿Y tú?
npc.en: Nice to meet you. My name is Carlos. And you?

opts.es: Mucho gusto, Carlos. Me llamo Max
opts.en: Nice to meet you, Carlos. My name is Max

steps.why: He gave his name and asked yours: greet him back and say your name.

npc.en: What do you do for work?

steps.why: "¿A qué te dedicas?" asks about your job, not where you live.

npc.en: How interesting! Do you have a business card?

steps.why: Hand over the card: "aquí tienes mi tarjeta".

title: Swap contacts
intro: The conversation with Laura went well. Time to stay in touch.

npc.es: Fue un gusto hablar contigo. ¿Nos conectamos en LinkedIn?
npc.en: It was a pleasure talking to you. Shall we connect on LinkedIn?

steps.why: "Con gusto" is the friendly yes.

npc.en: Can you give me your number?

opts.es: Sí, claro. Aquí está mi número

steps.why: She asked for your number, so you give it.

npc.es: Te escribo esta semana. ¿Cuándo te viene bien?
npc.en: I'll write to you this week. When works for you?

steps.why: She asked about timing, so name a day.

npc.en: Perfect. Let's keep in touch.

opts.en: Of course. Thanks for your time

steps.why: A warm close: thank her for her time.

title: Pitch a homeowner
intro: You knock on a door. Sr. Ramírez opens it. Use polite, formal Spanish.

npc.en: Good afternoon. How can I help you?

opts.es: Buenas tardes. Trabajo en energía solar. ¿Tiene un minuto?
opts.en: Good afternoon. I work in solar energy. Do you have a minute?

steps.why: Introduce yourself and ask for a minute, politely.

npc.es: Mi recibo de luz es muy caro.
npc.en: My electricity bill is very expensive.

opts.es: Podemos reducir su recibo de luz con paneles solares
opts.en: We can lower your electricity bill with solar panels

steps.why: Connect his problem to your solution.

npc.en: How much does the installation cost?

opts.es: Hacemos una cotización gratis. ¿Me muestra su recibo?
opts.en: We do a free quote. Can you show me your bill?

steps.why: Offer the free quote and ask for the bill. (The warranty is 25 años, not minutos!)

npc.en: Sounds good. When can you start?

opts.es: Podemos agendar una visita esta semana
opts.en: We can schedule a visit this week

steps.why: Move to the next step: book a visit.

title: "It's too expensive"
intro: Doña Elena likes solar but worries about the price. Stay formal.

npc.en: I don't know... it sounds very expensive.

opts.es: Se paga solo en pocos años
opts.en: It pays for itself in a few years

steps.why: Answer the objection with the payoff.

npc.en: And if I don't have money right now?

steps.why: Financing solves the cash problem.

npc.en: How long does the installation take?

steps.why: "Dos días" (two days) is not "las dos" (two o'clock).

npc.en: Alright. Will you send me the quote?

opts.es: Se la mando hoy. Gracias por su tiempo
opts.en: I'll send it to you today. Thanks for your time

steps.why: With a señora, stay formal: "su", not casual "sale" and "te".

title: First coffee date
intro: A first coffee with Ana. Relax and be yourself.

npc.en: Hi, how are you?

steps.why: Answer and ask back: "¿Y tú?"

npc.en: What do you like to do?

opts.en: I like to travel and dance

steps.why: "Me gusta…" talks about what you enjoy.

npc.en: Tell me about yourself. Where are you from?

steps.why: "¿De dónde eres?" asks where you're from. "Vivo aquí" says where you live.

npc.es: Me la estoy pasando muy bien contigo.
npc.en: I'm having a really good time with you.

opts.es: Yo también. Me encanta tu forma de ser
opts.en: Me too. I love the way you are

steps.why: Return the warmth.

title: The serious talk
intro: Second date. Ana wants to know what you're really looking for.

npc.en: What do you look for in a partner?

steps.why: Same verb "busco", very different meaning!

npc.en: And what is important to you?

opts.es: La familia es muy importante para mí
opts.en: Family is very important to me

steps.why: Share a real value.

npc.en: I like that you're honest.

opts.es: Gracias, me gusta pasar tiempo contigo
opts.en: Thanks, I like spending time with you

steps.why: Thank her and add something warm.

npc.es: ¿Nos vemos otra vez la próxima semana?
npc.en: Shall we see each other again next week?

steps.why: "Me encantaría" is a lovely yes.

title: Dinner for two
intro: You and your date arrive at a restaurant. The waiter greets you.

npc.en: Good evening. Table for how many people?

steps.why: "Para dos" = for two people.

npc.en: What would you like to drink?

opts.es: Una cerveza y un agua, por favor
opts.en: A beer and a water, please

steps.why: He asks about drinks: order them.

npc.en: Anything else?

opts.es: No, gracias. La cuenta, por favor

steps.why: Wrap up and ask for the bill.

npc.en: That's five hundred pesos. Cash or card?

steps.why: He offered two choices: pick one.

title: Lost in the city
intro: You can't find your hotel. A friendly stranger stops.

npc.en: Do you need help?

opts.en: Yes, I'm lost. Can you help me?

steps.why: Say what the problem is: "estoy perdido".

npc.en: Where are you going?

steps.why: "Estoy buscando…" names what you want to find.

npc.es: Está cerca. Todo recto y a la derecha.
npc.en: It's close. Straight ahead and to the right.

steps.why: A natural follow-up about distance.

npc.en: Five minutes walking.

opts.es: Muchas gracias. Que te vaya bien
opts.en: Thank you very much. All the best

steps.why: Thank her and say goodbye.
